name: Cool northwesterly
story: Late May on the island: a fresh northwesterly off the mountains, air so clean the far ranges look close enough to touch, small cumulus racing south. Cold at dawn, bright all day, and a long blue evening that never quite turns to night.
forecast: Clear and cool. Northwest 6 kt at dawn, 10-11 kt in the afternoon. Visibility 90 km. A few small cumulus. A twilit night, clear; a chance of aurora low in the north.
